asset.name: DragOverlay
asset.description: The portal-based drag representation following the pointer efficiently, preserving the source element's layout, indicating invalid targets, and animating to its resting place on drop.

requires.reason: Active drag state and target validity are shared.
Pointer tracking updates transforms directly rather than through React state.

rationale: Rendering the dragged item in a portal above every layer is what stops a drag from being clipped by the container it started in, which is the most common visible failure of hand-rolled drag.
